New - Don Leonard, the newly elected Ohio Democrat from a Trump district, said he drew red lines to Hakeem Jeffries in closed- door meeting last week to win his vote for speakership.

Said Jeffries would have to commit to putting bill on floor to zero out aid to Israel.

“He told me would study the issue,” Leonard said.

Also wants Jeffries — who has already said he would push to end Citizens United — to put the “full weight of speakership” behind amending Constitution and make clear “we are gonna get this done or we are gonna die trying” to reverse that ruling.

Says he may ask for a recorded vote in Dem leadership elections this week if Jeffries doesn’t meet his demands. (Jeffries wants to be nominated as speaker by voice vote.)

Says he told Jeffries the leader’s name is “synonymous” with low standing of Dem brand.

“He nodded,” Leonard said of Jeffries response.

Said senior House Dem members threatened to make his life a “living hell” if he doesn’t back Jeffries. (Won’t say who told him that.)

Says those were “promises” made to him

“This is what happens when you don’t go along with the team,” he said he was told.

“I am here to save the Democratic Party from itself,” he said of his party and its standing.

Said he’s prepared — if necessary — to be the lone Dem vote against Jeffries.
